div.div: مُفْصَحٌ [or as a n. of place from أَفْصَحُوا (see 4, last two sentences)] A place where the Christians celebrate the festival called الفِصْحُ [or Easter (A.) [And app. also A place where the Jews celebrate the festival so called by them, i. e. the Passover.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
